title: Zcash Founder Launches AI-Built Implementation of BLAKE3 Hash Function
summary:
Zooko Wilcox has introduced BLAKE3-Servil, a cryptographic hashing tool that he developed by using AI agents to optimize the existing BLAKE3 secure hash function. Wilcox stated that the AI-driven process allowed the new version to be faster and more secure, describing the approach as an "AI laser beam" compared to the low-quality output often associated with generative AI.

The BLAKE3 function is currently integrated into various systems software, including the build-ids for Android, Chrome, and Fuchsia. While Wilcox has called for human and AI engineers to submit reviews and further improvements to the codebase, the software's own documentation notes that the code has not yet been audited line by line by a human.

selectedTweets.text:
🏅 BLAKE3 JUST GOT A MASSIVE UPGRADE: SERVIL

@zooko launched a new implementation of BLAKE3 secure hash function, claiming he used AI gents to "make it *both* more secure *and* a lot faster"

BLAKE3 is already used in a lot of systems software (build tools, some Android/Chrome/Fuchsia build-ids, ZK systems, etc.) and competes with SHA-256 where pure software speed matters. it is typically much faster in software and has design advantages over raw SHA-256 (tree structure + no length-extension attacks).

zooko also invites contributors to both manually review the code base or point their own agents to it for further improvements
